decisions.rationale: The registered controller Popen handle and exact launch identity are already available, yet the PASS predicate does not bind the terminal status to them. That lets unattributed status/result evidence reach target acceptance and limitation credit. Adding the missing equality at the existing reap boundary and one mismatch regression is materially cheaper and safer than accepting provenance-incomplete physical acceptance; no broader isolation mechanism is required.
decisions.smallest_fix: Capture the controller status creation identity at candidate-controlled launch, require the terminal status PID and creation identity to equal that captured registered identity before PASS, and assert a mismatch remains FAIL and unmergeable.
